events.text: The institution was founded as a German Academy of Film Art (Deutsche Hochschule für Filmkunst) at Babelsberg Palace in Potsdam-Babelsberg.
events.subject: self
events.quote: founded on 1 November 1954 as a German Academy of Film Art

events.text: It was renamed the Film and Television Academy of the GDR.

events.text: It was named after director Konrad Wolf.

events.text: The institute was renamed to Academy for Film and Television.

events.text: The school was granted university status and renamed Konrad Wolf Film University of Babelsberg.
